mouth.base:
BRAND: Noseway (noseway.bg). PRODUCT: "Лепенки за уста" — mouth tape for sleep,
30 strips per pack. Worn over the lips at night to keep the mouth closed and force
nasal breathing.

REFERENCE IMAGES — THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT CONSTRAINT.
TWO reference images are attached and they are the source of truth. They override
everything else in this prompt.

  IMG 1 = THE PACK (the retail bag/box).
  IMG 2 = THE STRIP ITSELF (one loose mouth-tape strip, out of the pack).

They are two different objects and must never be confused with one another. Wherever
this prompt says "pack", render IMG 1. Wherever it says "strip", render IMG 2.

For BOTH images:
  · Reproduce the object EXACTLY as photographed: shape, silhouette, proportions,
    aspect ratio, colour, material, finish, sheen, edges, and any printing on it.
  · Do NOT redesign, restyle, recolour, simplify, translate or "improve" either one.
  · Do NOT add, remove or move any element. Do NOT mirror or rotate the logo.
    Every element must stay legible and correctly spelled.
  · Do NOT generate either object from imagination. If an angle is not covered by a
    reference, re-light and re-project the supplied one — do not invent that side.

Specific to IMG 1 (the pack): keep logo, wordmark, lockup, typography and claim text
exactly as shown. All packs in one image are the SAME product — identical to each
other and to the reference. Only position, angle and lighting may differ.

Specific to IMG 2 (the mouth strip): keep its exact outline, proportions,
thickness, colour and surface texture. Its real shape: a single STADIUM / PILL
outline — a rectangle whose two short ends are fully rounded into semicircles —
in a warm beige / nude tone, with a fine fibrous woven texture running across it,
and pierced by exactly ONE tall rounded-oval aperture centred in the middle.
It is NOT a plain rectangle, NOT a butterfly or two-lobed shape, and it has ONE
opening, never two. Do not draw it as a nasal strip, a plaster or a bandage.

ORIENTATION: the reference photo shows the strip standing VERTICALLY. Worn, it sits
HORIZONTALLY across the lips — so rotate it 90° whenever it appears on a face, and
keep it vertical only when it is lying loose as a product still.

If the supplied IMG 2 differs from this description in any way, the IMAGE wins —
copy what you see.

Treat this as a compositing task: place the real pack and the real strip into a new
scene. It is not a redesign task.

OFFER: 2 + 1 free. Buy two packs, get the third free. 3 packs = 90 strips = about
three months of nights.

NO PRICES — ABSOLUTE RULE. Never render a price, a currency symbol, a per-unit
cost, a struck-through amount or a shipping threshold anywhere on the image. Not in
the headline, not in a badge, not in a caption, not in fine print, not on a receipt
or a tag. The offer is communicated as a RATIO ("2+1", "третата е безплатна",
"три за цената на две") and as QUANTITY (packs, strips, nights) — never as money.
If a layout below seems to call for a figure, use nights or strips instead.

STRICT BRAND PALETTE — use ONLY these:
  #163343  deep navy      — headlines, dark surfaces
  #2b52a1  royal blue     — accents, pills, buttons, highlights
  #97c4d5  light blue     — soft gradients, secondary surfaces
  #f6f7f9  off-white      — backgrounds
  #353030  ink            — body copy
  Single permitted extra: warm yellow #FFD43B, ONLY on the "БЕЗПЛАТНО" tag.
  NO gold, NO beige, NO cream, NO champagne. Nothing warm except the yellow tag.

  EXEMPTION — this palette governs the SCENE ONLY: background, surfaces, props,
  ribbons, typography, badges and graphic shapes. The product pack itself keeps its
  own real colours from the reference image. Never recolour the pack.

MANDATORY OFFER BADGE — every creative carries it, no exceptions:
A solid royal blue #2b52a1 badge, rounded-square or circular, thin white keyline.
Inside, centred, white Rubik:
  "2+1"        — very large, heavy, dominant
  "БЕЗПЛАТНО"  — small, letterspaced uppercase, beneath
Roughly 18–22% of image width, tilted ~8°, soft drop shadow. Must NOT overlap the
headline, the pack logo, or any pack's front face.

TYPEFACE: Rubik or a close geometric sans. FORMAT: 1:1 square (2048×2048) unless stated.

DEPICTING THE PRODUCT IN USE: render IMG 2 sitting horizontally across the CLOSED
lips, centred under the nose, following the curve of the mouth and lying flat on
the skin with a soft natural shadow at its edges. Never over the nostrils, never
covering the chin. Scale it to real life: it spans the mouth, not the whole lower
face. Keep its exact shape and colour from IMG 2.

RULES: All on-image text in Bulgarian, spelled EXACTLY as given. No extra text, no
watermark. Photoreal product render, soft studio shadow. No faces unless stated.

OFFER WORDING RULE: whenever the 2+1 offer appears as text, it MUST make clear it is about PACKS (опаковки), e.g. "Вземи 2 опаковки, третата е подарък" or "2 опаковки + 1 подарък" — never a bare "2+1" that could read as single strips. A small graphic "2+1 БЕЗПЛАТНО" badge is fine only if the word "опаковки" appears somewhere else in the creative. NEVER show a price.

nose.base:
BRAND: Noseway (noseway.bg). PRODUCT: "Лепенки за нос" — nasal strips, 30 strips per pack.

REFERENCE IMAGES — THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT CONSTRAINT.
TWO reference images are attached and they are the source of truth. They override
everything else in this prompt.

  IMG 1 = THE PACK (the retail bag).
  IMG 2 = THE NASAL STRIP ITSELF (one loose strip, out of the pack).

Wherever this prompt says "pack", render IMG 1. Wherever it says "strip", IMG 2.

For BOTH: reproduce the object EXACTLY as photographed — shape, silhouette,
proportions, aspect ratio, colour, material, finish, sheen, edges and any printing.
Do NOT redesign, restyle, recolour, simplify, translate or "improve" either one.
Do NOT add, remove or move any element, and do NOT mirror or rotate the logo.
Do NOT generate either object from imagination; if an angle is not covered, re-light
and re-project the supplied one rather than inventing that side.

Specific to IMG 1 (the pack): keep logo, wordmark, lockup, typography and claim text
exactly as shown. All packs in one image are the SAME product — identical to each
other and to the reference. Only position, angle and lighting may differ.

EXACT DESCRIPTION OF IMG 1 (anchor — the pack looks like THIS, never a variation):
a BRIGHT ROYAL-BLUE stand-up pouch (vivid blue, NOT dark navy). At the very top, a
sealed strip with white centred caps "30 БРОЯ ЛЕПЕНКИ". In the upper middle, the white
wordmark "NOSEWAY" in clean caps, with a TEAL/CYAN breath-swirl curl coming off its
right side. Below it, a WHITE thin-line drawing of a calm YOUNG MAN'S face, front-facing,
EYES OPEN, hair swept up, with a small nose strip drawn across the bridge of his nose.
Under the face, white caps "ЛЕПЕНКИ ЗА НОС" and smaller "ЗА СВОБОДНО ДИШАНЕ". Near the
bottom, a small realistic nose-strip graphic. Everything on the pack is white/teal on
bright blue. If your rendering comes out dark navy, with closed eyes, or without the
teal swirl — it is WRONG; match the bright-blue open-eyed reference.

Specific to IMG 2 (the nasal strip): its real shape is an HOURGLASS / BOWTIE —
wide rounded lobes at both ends narrowing to a waist in the middle — in soft white
non-woven fabric, carrying THREE parallel raised spring bands running lengthwise
down its centre. It is NOT a plain rectangle, NOT a plaster, and the three bands
are never fewer or more. Keep its exact outline, texture and matte white tone.

ORIENTATION: the reference shows the strip standing VERTICALLY. Worn, it sits
HORIZONTALLY across the bridge of the nose — rotate it 90° whenever it appears on a
face, and keep it vertical only when lying loose as a product still.

If a supplied reference differs from these descriptions in any way, the IMAGE wins —
copy what you see.

Treat this as a compositing task: place the real pack and the real strip into a new
scene. It is not a redesign task.

OFFER: 2 + 1 free. 3 packs = 90 strips. 29,98 € instead of 53,97 €. −44%. 0,33 €/strip.

MANDATORY OFFER BADGE — every single creative must carry it, no exceptions:
A solid royal blue #2b52a1 badge, rounded-square or circular, with a thin white
inner keyline. Inside, centred, in white Rubik:
  "2+1"          — very large, heavy, the dominant element of the badge
  "БЕЗПЛАТНО"    — small, letterspaced uppercase, directly beneath
The badge sits at roughly 18–22% of the image width, tilted about 8° for a sticker
feel, with a soft drop shadow so it reads as applied on top of the scene.
It must NOT overlap the headline, the logo on the pack, or any pack's front face.
This badge is the offer tag — the viewer must grasp "2+1" in under half a second,
without reading the headline.

STRICT BRAND PALETTE — use ONLY these:
  #163343  deep navy      — headlines, dark surfaces
  #2b52a1  royal blue     — accents, pills, buttons, highlights
  #97c4d5  light blue     — soft gradients, secondary surfaces
  #f6f7f9  off-white      — backgrounds
  #353030  ink            — body copy
  Single permitted extra: warm yellow #FFD43B, ONLY on the "БЕЗПЛАТНО" tag.
  NO gold, NO beige, NO cream, NO champagne. That is the reference brand's palette,
  not ours. Nothing warm anywhere except the yellow tag.

  EXEMPTION — this palette governs the SCENE ONLY: background, surfaces, props,
  ribbons, typography, badges and graphic shapes. The product pack itself keeps its
  own real colours from the reference image, whatever they are. Never recolour the
  pack to fit this palette.

TYPEFACE: Rubik, or a close geometric sans. Headlines heavy/bold, uppercase where noted.

FORMAT: 1:1 square (2048×2048) unless stated.. Headline occupies the top 25–35% and must be
readable at thumbnail size on a phone.

RULES: All on-image text in Bulgarian, spelled EXACTLY as given. No extra text,
no watermark, no logos other than Noseway. Photoreal product render, soft studio
shadow, clean edges. No hands or faces unless stated.

OFFER WORDING RULE: whenever the 2+1 offer appears as text, it MUST make clear it is about PACKS (опаковки), e.g. "Вземи 2 опаковки, третата е подарък" or "2 опаковки + 1 подарък" — never a bare "2+1" that could read as single strips. A small graphic "2+1 БЕЗПЛАТНО" badge is fine only if the word "опаковки" appears somewhere else in the creative. NEVER show a price.

LOGO LOCKUP — CRITICAL, the model keeps getting this wrong:
The wordmark is "NOSEWAY" in PLAIN WHITE capital letters — every letter white, including a NORMAL round letter "O" (the O is just an O, NEVER replaced by a swirl, circle, spiral or icon). The teal/cyan breath-swirl is a SEPARATE decorative flourish sitting to the RIGHT of and slightly above the word — it does NOT touch or replace any letter. If unsure, render "NOSEWAY" as seven plain white capitals and put the swirl clearly apart on the right.
